teaser: What happens when the hunger to go first meets the instinct to keep what already works running smoothly? Life path 1 is the number of starting alone, trusting your own read before anyone else's. ISFJ is built around steady care, the eye that notices what a room needs before it's asked. Cross the two and you get someone who leads from the back of the room: the one who starts the project, then stays up past midnight making sure everyone else's name is on the credit list before their own.
excerpt: "You already finished the assignment," he says, watching you close the notebook before the teacher has even collected the others.
